checks: Actual DashOverride starts the window: early hostile crossings grant one counter per dash without damage; ordinary invulnerability and crossings after 0.12 seconds grant none.
A miss preserves the charge; the next connected slash deals exactly 1.5x once, including multiple victims. The following slash, direct IceNova and companion StrikeEnemy keep their normal damage.
Menu/party pause freeze the charge and run clock. Active production Update expires it after three seconds; an actual hit cancels it immediately.

Four real Update-driven clears: two clean floors build streak 2; shield contact and health damage each break flawless status. Rewards/NextFloor preserve totals and reset floor-local state; repeated updates never recount a clear.
